description_en: Modifies a flow control rule by calling the ModifyFlowRule operation
description_zh: 调用ModifyFlowRule接口修改流控规则
kebab_example: aliyun ahas-openapi modify-flow-rule --namespace default --rule-id 123 --relation-strategy 0 --threshold 50.0 --limit-origin default --ref-resource handleServiceB --control-behavior 0 --warm-up-period-sec 30 --max-queueing-time-ms 2000 --ahas-region-id cn-hangzhou --threshold-mode 2 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyFlowRule

parameters.help_en: The statistical dimension. Valid values: 0: current interface. 1: associated interface. 2: chain entrance
parameters.help_zh: 统计维度。0表示当前接口，1表示关联接口，2表示链路入口
parameters.name: relation_strategy

parameters.help_en: The name of the associated interface or the entrance resource name. This parameter is required when RelationStrategy is set to 1 (associated interface) or 2 (chain entrance)
parameters.help_zh: 关联接口名、入口资源名。当统计维度relationStrategy值为1（关联接口）或2（链路入口）时，需要设置该字段
parameters.name: ref_resource

parameters.help_en: The flow control behavior. Valid values: 0: fast fail. 1: warm-up. 2: queue waiting
parameters.help_zh: 流控效果。0表示快速失败，1表示预热启动，2表示排队等待
parameters.name: control_behavior

parameters.help_en: The warm-up period, in seconds. This parameter is required when ControlBehavior is set to 1 (warm-up)
parameters.help_zh: 预热时间。当controlBehavior值为1（预热启动）时，需要设置该字段
parameters.name: warm_up_period_sec

parameters.help_en: The timeout period, in milliseconds. This parameter is required when ControlBehavior is set to 2 (queue waiting)
parameters.help_zh: 超时时间。当controlBehavior值为2（排队等待）时，需要设置该字段
parameters.name: max_queueing_time_ms
